sentences.text: 4. By such order dated 5th March 2025, the learned Tribunal granted compensation in favour of the claimants to the tune of Rs.5,00,000/- together with interest under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act.

5. Mr. Saibalendu Bhowmik, learned Advocate for the appellant-Insurance Company submits that the Insurance Company has already deposited the statutory amount of Rs.25,000/- vide Challan National Insurance Company Ltd vs Sudip Dutta & Ors on 22 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120173904/
1 No.335(A) dated 10.06.2025 with the learned Registrar General of this Court and is ready and willing to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory deposit within such time as would be directed by this Court.

entities.text: Challan National Insurance Company Ltd vs Sudip Dutta & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On such count, he prays for stay of operation of the impugned judgement and award of the learned Tribunal.
He files photocopy of challan which is taken on record.

6. The report of the Computer Section, Appellate Side, High Court, Calcutta dated 18th September,
2025 shows that no caveat has been lodged.

7. The photocopy of challan being No.335(A) dated 10th June, 2025 (original to be produced at the time of hearing) shows deposit of statutory amount of Rs.25,000/- in terms of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act with the Registry of this Court.
The office report dated 4th September, 2025 also shows deposit of the statutory deposit.

8. In view of readiness and willingness on the part of the appellant-Insurance Company to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory amount, there shall be stay of operation of the impugned judgment and award passed by the learned Tribunal for a period of four weeks.

The appellant-Insurance Company is directed to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory amount before the learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta within a period of four weeks from date.
9. In default to make deposit of the aforesaid amount, the order of stay shall stand automatically vacated without reference to this Court.

10. Learned Registrar General of this Court shall ensure that the amount to be deposited by the appellant-Insurance Company be invested in a short-term auto renewable scheme of any nationalised bank, until further orders.
11. The appellant-Insurance Company is directed to serve copy of this application upon the respondents and file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

12. Let the matter appear two weeks after reopening of this Court after ensuing winter vacation under the heading 'Application' before the appropriate Bench having determination.
< (Bivas Pattanayak, J.)
